tag.name: Google tag - GA4
tag.notes: Fires once per page on initialize_dataLayer (the first push on every page), so the page values are already in the data layer. Automatic page_view is off: the GA4 - page_view tag sends it with the spec parameters.

trigger.name: Block - GPC enabled
trigger.notes: Blocking trigger on every tag: matches any event while the browser sends Global Privacy Control.

variable.name: Const - GA4 Measurement ID
variable.notes: Replace the value with the GA4 web stream measurement ID (Admin > Data streams). Starts with G-.

variable.name: JS - GPC enabled
variable.notes: true when the browser sends Global Privacy Control. Every tag is blocked when it is true.

variable.name: Lookup - traffic_type
variable.notes: internal_traffic "true" becomes traffic_type "internal" (for the GA4 Internal traffic data filter). Anything else stays undefined, so the parameter is not sent.
